onboarding.welcome_copy: Accounts, budgets and bills in one calm place. Free, and your financial data stays on this phone.

privacy.ai_body: Only when you use AI chat or receipt scanning with your own key. Chat sends what you type or tap as a question (suggested questions may name an account or quote a note), the earlier messages of the current chat, and the data the AI looks up to answer: totals and transactions with dates, types, categories, budgets, amounts and currencies, plus your account names, without merchants or notes. Receipt scanning sends the photo and your category names. Both go straight from this phone to the provider you picked, OpenAI or Anthropic. No key, no requests. The provider’s own privacy policy and charges apply.
privacy.changes_body: If this policy changes, the new version appears on this screen with a new date.
privacy.children_body: Spendwise isn’t directed at children under 13 and doesn’t knowingly collect information from them.
privacy.choices_body: Remove your AI key in Settings › Spendwise AI. Delete data in Settings › Privacy and data, or uninstall the app to remove everything stored on this phone.
privacy.errors_body: Only while “Share anonymous error reports” is on (it is on by default). When something fails, the error message and stack trace go to PostHog with the context the app adds (which part of the app failed, the component stack, or the dates and services of a failed exchange-rate download), plus your device model, operating system, app version, language, time zone and a random ID for this install. The app doesn’t add amounts, account or category names, merchants or notes. No usage events are sent, no person profile is built, and your IP address isn’t used to look up your location.
privacy.files_body: Backup and CSV files leave the phone only when you share or save them somewhere yourself. Automatic backups stay in the app’s storage, which your phone’s own system backup (iCloud or Google) may include, depending on your phone settings.
privacy.hero_body: Accounts, transactions, categories, budgets, recurring rules and backups are stored on this device. There is no Spendwise account and no Spendwise server.
privacy.hero_title: Your money data stays on this phone
privacy.maps_body: Tapping a transaction’s location opens Apple Maps or your phone’s maps app with that address. That app’s own privacy policy applies.
privacy.rates_body: To convert currencies, the app downloads exchange rates from Frankfurter (api.frankfurter.dev), ExchangeRate-API (open.er-api.com) or the free currency API by fawazahmed0 (cdn.jsdelivr.net, currency-api.pages.dev). Requests contain only dates and currency codes. Like any website, these services see your IP address.
privacy.stores_body: Google Play and the App Store handle downloads and updates under their own privacy policies.
privacy.updates_body: When the app starts, it asks Expo’s update service (u.expo.dev) for fixes. The request contains the platform, release channel, runtime and update versions and a random ID for this install, never your data. Like any website, Expo sees your IP address.
